color.$description: Primitive colour scales. Families other than `up` and `network` are the LUKSO base layer generated from HSL (hue, saturation, lightness step); values are the exact hex output of that generator and must not be redefined here. `up` is the Universal Profiles accent family proposed by this system.

neutral.$description: Hue 206, saturation 30 percent. The canvas, ink, border and shadow family used by every product surface.

35.$description: Focused input border; hue reference for ink-tinted shadows.

90.$description: Default border, skeleton base, fallback avatar background.

up.$description: Universal Profiles accent: hue 229, saturation 78 percent, generated by the same HSL generator as the base layer. The ramp is anchored on the periwinkle swatch #6981EC that the Universal Profile Board labels (step 67 reproduces it exactly) and passes close to the board's #8494EE (step 73) and the app icon gradient #A7ACF9 to #6E7BE6 (steps 82 to 67). The board shows the swatches without roles, variable bindings or sign-off, so the family and every role that uses it stay proposed until the owner confirms the anchor (OPEN-01).

up.note: Evidence band: board 229-231 degrees, app icon 234-236, posters 227-231, stage deck 246. No shipped product surface consumes an accent today; the mobile app uses purple.51 for four secondary labels and the web relies on neutrals.

82.$description: Brand gradient start (mirrors the app icon top #A7ACF9). Near the board tint #A4B5FF, which is more saturated; see up.observed.board-3.

78.$description: Dark-mode accent text and links (7.90:1 on neutral.10).

73.$description: Dark-mode brand colour; nearest ramp step to the board and poster lockup tint #8494EE (6.42:1 on neutral.10).

67.$description: Brand key colour, equal to the labelled board swatch. 3.53:1 on white: icons, large text and fills that carry no text.

up.note: Value observed exactly on the board (label node 1131:25998); the role as brand key is proposed.

56.$description: Light-mode accent text, links and accent fills: 5.72:1 on white, 5.47:1 on the canvas, 4.91:1 on the opaque glass tint, 5.04:1 on the 96 tint; white text on it reaches 5.72:1.

observed.$description: Exact periwinkle values read from evidence, kept separate from the ramp so their provenance stays visible. None carries a role or an approval; do not use them in components. The ramp step 67 equals board-1.

up.note: Values only; the source files are private. Cited by file key and node id.

board-1.$description: Swatch 1 on the Universal Profile Board colour palette section (node 1131:25994, labelled by text node 1131:25998). 3.53:1 on white, 4.94:1 on neutral.10.

board-2.$description: Swatch 2 (node 1131:25997, labelled by 1131:25999); also the sampled lockup tint on the 2025 posters. 2.82:1 on white, 6.19:1 on neutral.10.

board-3.$description: Swatch 3 (node 1131:25996, unlabelled). Tint only on light canvases: 1.98:1 on white, 8.83:1 on neutral.10.

app-icon-top.$description: Sampled top of the shipped app icon gradient (hue 236).

up.note: Sampled from a raster; not an exact design value.

app-icon-bottom.$description: Sampled bottom of the shipped app icon gradient (hue 234).

up.note: Sampled from a raster; not an exact design value.

green.$description: Hue 135, saturation 57 percent. Success and confirmation.

30.$description: Success text on light surfaces (5.52:1 on white, 4.73:1 on glass).

up.note: Extension of the existing hsl(135,57%) scale; the observed steps (45 and above) fail 4.5:1 as text on light surfaces.

35.$description: Success fill that keeps 3:1 against white and carries white text at 4.28:1.

up.note: Extension of the existing scale for switch on-state and success buttons.

54.$description: Observed success icon and check colour. 2.06:1 on white: decorative only.

red.$description: Hue 0, saturation 75 percent. Errors and destructive actions.

45.$description: Error text and danger button text on light surfaces (5.71:1 on white, 4.90:1 on glass).

up.note: Extension of the existing hsl(0,75%) scale; observed red.55 reaches only 4.36:1 as text.

55.$description: Observed error border and error label colour. Passes 3:1 as a component boundary; use red.45 for text.

65.$description: Dark-mode error text (5.34:1 on neutral.10); observed danger button border.

yellow.$description: Hue 36, saturation 100 percent. Warnings and the testnet signal.

25.$description: Warning text on light surfaces (7.05:1 on white).

35.$description: Standalone warning icons and indicators on light surfaces (4.18:1 on white).

up.note: Extension of the existing hsl(36,100%) scale; yellow.65 cannot reach 3:1 against white on its own.

65.$description: Warning fill and testnet colour; carries neutral.20 text at 7.35:1. Never used as text on light surfaces.

40.$description: Info text on light surfaces (6.89:1 on white).

purple.$description: Hue 230, saturation 24 percent. Muted slate used for text tags; not the accent.

up.note: Production uses purple.51 in four places for secondary labels. Keep for those roles; the accent is color.up.

lukso.$description: Hue 335, saturation 33 percent. Desaturated LUKSO tint family from the base layer.

up.note: The mobile copy carries only steps 70, 80 and 90.
Step 93 exists only in the mobile copy.

network.$description: Fixed network identity colours. Used for network tags, token logos and dots; never as text on light surfaces.

lukso-mainnet.$description: LUKSO magenta. Reserved for the LUKSO network and LYX; never a Universal Profiles accent.

up.note: Production hard-codes #FFB84C in five files while the palette step yellow.65 is #FFB84D; the one-unit difference is invisible and the palette value wins.

base-ink.$description: Base network ink used behind its logo.

ethereum.$description: Placeholder for the Ethereum network colour. Production renders the Ethereum logo without a fixed colour; the value must be confirmed before use.

up.note: Placeholder taken from the Ethereum brand's commonly published hue; replace once the product fixes a value.

static.$description: Fixed values that do not change with theme.

glass-base.$description: Opaque base of the light glass tint (between neutral.95 and neutral.97).

legacy.$description: Base-layer families with no Universal Profiles role. Exported for migration only; do not use in new work.

up.note: Zero direct references in the mobile app except through the username gradient prop.
